rule: Owner decision 2026-10-31 (JUN-640): game-engine-specific parts stay in kotoba-lang/kami-engine; parts used, or expected to be used, outside a game engine (3D processing, physics, CAE, robotics, media production) go to kotoba-lang/kotoba lib/. Dependencies point from kami-engine to kotoba lib/, never back.
status: proposed 2026-10-31; entries apply the rule and stand unless the owner overrides them; kami-creative-studio decided by the owner 2026-10-31

values.kami-engine: stays in or moves to kotoba-lang/kami-engine
values.kotoba: stays in or moves to kotoba-lang/kotoba lib/
values.split: the library is divided; `split` says which namespaces go where
values.owner: the rule does not decide it; waiting for the owner
